caption:
There are so many weird ADHD hacks because ADHD brains were never built for “normal” life.

People with ADHD will drink coffee to sleep.
Need background noise to focus.
Pace while thinking.
Work better under pressure.
Forget what they were saying mid-sentence.
Avoid a 5 minute task for 5 weeks.

And after years of struggling, you start building tiny survival tricks just to get through the day.

But ADHD is more than quirky habits.
It’s nervous system exhaustion most people never see.

Imagine not needing to fight your brain all the time.
More focus. More calm. Less overwhelm. Less burnout.

That’s why I created my natural ADHD treatment guide for women 🤍
 (It’s in my profile description)🎁
author: Adhd Treatment
transcript: I'm gonna share with you guys some really weird hacks that my therapist shared with me for my ADHD that strangely work First one is to throw the blanket off of me when I wake up as soon as I wake up I don't even think about it. I just immediately toss the blanket literally across my room action triggers my brain into thinking Okay, we're up. We're ready. Let's go But you can't think about it too much because then you're gonna stay in bed You catch yourself stuck in a loop of doom scrolling instead of saying, okay get up and stop scrolling Stand up and scroll half of the challenge is already standing up So if you just trigger your brain into standing up You're eventually gonna get tired of doom scrolling and standing and you're gonna want to go do something I'll creating your to-do list and planning your day. Make sure to plan time for doing nothing like Intentionally tell yourself to do nothing If you actually let yourself rest your brain is gonna stop trying to steal the rest throughout the day You'll obviously be avoiding procrastination This was my favorite but find a way to break down your days in a fun way a time block my day So I leave no space to think and the app that I use sends me notification So I literally don't miss a single task The last one is one that I really unintentionally did but it's pretending to vlog throughout your day So as you're getting things done and doing things just talk to yourself pretend you're vlogging pretend recording for a YouTube video only doesn't Make getting things done so much more fun But it also kind of keeps you distracted while doing two things at once You know if you try any of these out because these are actually my favorite hacks
title: Weird ADHD Hacks That Actually Work
one_liner: Therapist-backed ADHD hacks that trick your brain into focus, action, and less overwhelm.
key_points: Toss your blanket immediately on waking — physical action signals your brain it's time to start
Stand up while doom-scrolling to break the loop; your body will naturally want to move on
Schedule intentional rest so your brain stops stealing it through distraction and procrastination
Pretend to vlog your day to stay engaged and make tasks feel more fun and purposeful
